en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a wide, straight street lined with ornate multi‑story buildings leading toward a tall neo‑Gothic church tower. A few pedestrians walk along the sidewalks. The word "GRAZ." is printed at the top. At the lower right, the street name "Nibelungengasse." is printed. There is a circular stamp reading "STEIERM. LANDES-ARCHIV" and the year "1903" on the lower right margin. Along the left edge appears a vertical publisher/date line.
